proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute)-[:FILED_BY]->(c:Customer)-[:HOLDS]->(a:Account)<-[:ABOUT]-(e:AccountEvent)-[:CHANGED_PHONE_TO]->(p:Phone), (e)-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(dev:Device), (d)-[:DISPUTES]->(t:Transaction)-[:FROM_DEVICE]->(dev), (t)-[:FROM_IP]->(ip:IP) WHERE p.id = 'PHN-C11-NEW' RETURN d, c, a, e, p, dev, t, ip
proof_patterns.name: phone change to shared takeover infrastructure
